subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures be suppressed before mutating handling even when detail mode is enabled, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface several exec detail cases, while this PR and its linked issue request suppressing exec-like warnings regardless of `includeDetails`; automation should not choose that user-facing warning policy.

options.title: Clarify Policy Then Repair
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning policy first, then reorder the suppression logic and update tests to match it before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Replace
options.body: If suppress-all is not the desired policy, pause or close this branch and replace it with a narrower fix for the confirmed warning leak.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy Then Repair
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning policy first, then reorder the suppression logic and update tests to match it before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and blame place this handle closest to the warning-policy and mutation-helper surfaces affected by the decision.
